about_the_game:
When the last recovery potion ran out in his pouch, Morris gently closed the old scripture that had accompanied him for twenty years. This priest who always chanted prayers at the rear of mercenary groups now leaned on his nephew Light's shoulder, searching for a true "home" on a faded parchment map. They traversed wilderness still drifting with the embers of war, finally arriving at a town forgotten even by gods—

Here they will meet wanderers from various lands who have grown weary of roaming. Please don't inquire about their pasts, but join them in building this town into everyone's ideal home.

[Game Features]

Building System

※ Upgrade various buildings to higher levels through construction and production.
※ Different buildings produce unique resources. Arrange automated structures to streamline your construction
※ Customize town landscapes: relocate buildings, lay cobblestone paths, decorate with garden benches

Character Expedition System

※ Dispatch town residents on exploration missions
※ Bring back rare materials, design blueprints, and decorative items from forests/mines/ancient cities

※ Each expedition may trigger character-specific storylines, unlocking hidden buildings

Immersive Hand-Drawn World

※ Charming cartoon art style offering immersive fantasy town life

When sunset gilds the windmill's edges, when wheat fields ripple with rustling melodies, you'll use steaming beet soup, the aroma of fresh-baked bread, and the symphony of construction to build a home where all wanderers can finally remove their armor.

short_description: Retired pastor Morris and his nephew rebuild a shabby town. They build and upgrade structures, manage resources, send ex-adventurers to explore for supplies and blueprints, and share warm daily life with unique townsfolk. A refreshing hand-drawn healing management game—create your own peaceful home.
